title: BROKEN AND USELESS AFTER 1 YEAR!!
text: BROKEN AND USELESS AFTER 1 YEAR!!. I AM SO VERY DISAPPOINTED THAT I SPENT TIME ORDERING AND SELECTING this, ONLY TO HAVE IT NO LONGER WORK!!  There is no reason as I took very careful care of it.  I am truly upset that Amazon nor the maker will replace this.  I truly would not buy it again - Money NOT well spent.  I am on a budget and cannot afford to replace it.

product_metadata.title: Courant Cordless 1.2L Electric Kettle Stainless Steel, Great for tea coffee and all your hot water needs
features: 1.2 litre capacities: Prepare invigorating teas, comforting hot chocolate, and all of your favourite warm beverages without the hassle of using conventional stovetop methods. It boils water 60% faster than a microwave and is safe and easy to use with the added convenience of the automatic shut-off feature. Simply fill it with water, turn it on, and it will take care of the rest.

Stainless steel body: The polished stainless steel finish makes for easy maintenance while the cordless 360° rotational base enables effortless handling. The wide opening makes it easy to fill and pour out water.

360 degree rotational body with separated base: A 360-degree swivel ensures that you can pick it up from any side. Just plug it in and place it on your kitchen counter so that everyone in your family can pour themselves a steaming cup or water for their tea or coffee.

Wrap around cord storage: Power cable length adjustable as required for easy storage. Instead of using precious, and expensive, gas resources in your home to make your favourite coffee, tea, and other hot beverages every morning, an electric kettle provides a more cost efficient way to get you started.

Automatic shut off when water boils or dry: Automatic shutoff feature with boil-dry protection, you never have to worry about a hazard should you walk away and forget. As Most of us have put a kettle on the stove, forgotten, and returned later to a hot, bone-dry pot. Luckily an automatic shutoff function turns off the electric kettle when the water has boiled.
